FY2025 delivered $67.54B revenue (+7.6% YoY), $10.59B net income (+76% YoY), and $14.7B free cash flow -- a decade high. The GenAI book of business stands at $12.5B cumulative (up from $9.5B QoQ), with software comprising >$2B and consulting >$10.5B. Q4 2025 was remarkable: revenue up 12% YoY (9% CC), software up 11%, infrastructure up 17% (Z17 mainframe cycle), and consulting grew modestly but with AI bookings accelerating. UNH.bottom_line: UNH closed at $277.26 on April 2 (last trading day before Easter weekend). The stock is down ~16–18% YTD in 2026 and down ~47–50% over the past 12 months, marking one of the worst performances among large-cap healthcare names. The 52-week range spans approximately $234.60 – $606.36, reflecting the catastrophic multiple compression cycle that began in mid-2024 and accelerated through 2025 into 2026. At ~$277, the stock trades at roughly 15.5x forward FY2026 EPS consensus of $17.69 — well below its historical 20–25x range and near a decade-low valuation floor.

ADBE.bottom_line: ADBE trades around the mid-$230s, well below prior ~$330 resistance and above major support near $170, after a sharp pullback from 2025 highs.[1][2] Technicals are range-bound into Q2 FY26 earnings with investors weighing strong ARR growth against AI/valuation concerns.

bull_case.thesis_headline: Beat on Q2 revenue/EPS (print at or above high end of guide), strong AI-first ARR acceleration, and a meaningful raise to FY26 revenue/EPS and ARR guidance.[2]

pushes_higher.text: Can Adobe sustain double‑digit ARR and revenue growth as AI-first ARR scales, or does growth normalize toward high single digits post-2026?[2][5]
Will generative AI (Firefly and AI-first features) materially expand wallet share and ARPU without triggering customer pushback on pricing and credit bundles?[2]
Can Digital Experience (DX/Experience Cloud) re-accelerate meaningfully in a mixed macro and competitive environment, justifying a growth premium multiple?

base_case.setup_headline: In-line Q2 results (around mid-to-high end of guide), stable but not accelerating ARR, and essentially unchanged FY26 guide with balanced AI commentary.[2]
